user_id.description: Reference to the visitor or buyer profile that submitted the inquiry.

name.description: Full name of the buyer contact.

country.description: Country or market where the buyer is based.

product_category.description: Main product category the buyer wants to source.

product_details.description: Product specifications, requirements, materials, target standards, or reference details.

target_quantity.description: Expected order quantity or estimated annual volume.

services_needed.description: Sourcing support services requested by the buyer.

timeline.description: Expected sourcing, sample, production, or shipment timeline.

budget_range.description: Indicative target budget or price range if available.

shipping_destination.description: Destination country, port, warehouse, or address for shipment coordination.

message.description: Additional notes or questions from the buyer.

status.description: Internal review status for the inquiry.

submitted_at.description: Date and time when the inquiry was submitted.
